name: Midas Golden Touch 2
review:
The Midas sequel on a 3x5 grid with 15 lines. Multiplier wilds, the Gift of Midas feature and a bonus game with sticky respins make up the package.

Gift of Midas adds a golden twist to ordinary spins, and in the bonus winning symbols hold while everything else respins. Medium volatility with a 15,000x cap is an unusual combo. The published RTP is 94.27%, below average.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
